active_continuity: The Blood-Sword Demon Lord serves the Lord of Heaven and commands the invading army.
Jeok Cheongang is injured but holding off the Blood-Sword Demon Lord while Jin Taekyung targets the mages.
Jin Taekyung defeated Level 175 So Gunak; the resulting level-up restored his body.
Fire Dragon Armor is severely damaged, stored in Inventory, and unavailable until its automatic repair completes in three days.
Jin continues fighting the surviving enemies and mages; he cuts Taishan at the chapter’s end.
The Grand Mage expects Jin to survive and reacts to his revival with anticipation.
The mages’ body-enhancement Magic requires its target to be alive and has limits.
